links.comparator_used: Uncalibrated model probabilities applied without refitting in temporal and external (eICU-CRD) validation
links.outcome: Calibration of predicted risk of haemodynamic intolerance under temporal and geographic shift
links.effect: Uncalibrated predictions over-predicted when prevalence fell (temporal split) and under-predicted when it rose (external cohort); a single logistic recalibration largely corrected the shift in both directions. Discrimination was unchanged (GB AUROC 0.733 temporal, 0.767 external). No numeric post-recalibration calibration metrics were given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The model should be recalibrated locally before use, so local data are needed. Prospective impact evaluation has not yet been done.
links.quote: In contrast, calibration shifted predictably with event prevalence — over-prediction when prevalence fell across the temporal split and under-prediction when it rose in the external cohort — while the calibration slope remained close to, or slightly below, one; a single logistic recalibration largely corrected the shift in both directions.
